summary: Iteration 6: Verified the reliability fix in sap_soap_client._safe_fetch_by_output_product (3-attempt retry with 1.5s/3s backoff on SAPSoapError). Extended backend_test.py with TestFlt2StabilityAcrossRepeatedRuns (kept inside the TestBomSearch loadscope worker to avoid ingress overload). pytest: 9/9 PASS in 85s including 4 back-to-back FLT2_4.1 searches — each returned total_components=91, max_level=5, len(rows)=91, INSTRUCTION MANUAL level-1 row product_id=6902-602142 / eco_id=FLT2_4.4 with ZERO fluctuation to 89 or stale values. Regression: 8060522_1=23/2 and INVALID_BOM_999→404 both pass. Playwright E2E on public URL ran the search 3 more times through the real UI: every run showed Total Components 91 / Max Level 5 / Active Materials 91 / 91 <tr> rows / manual row '6902-602142 INSTRUCTION MANUAL FLT2 1 EA FLT2_4.4'. 8060522_1 UI = 23/2, INVALID_BOM_999 UI = 'Lookup failed: BOM INVALID_BOM_999 not found in SAP' via bom-search-error-alert. SAP Connected indicator green. Per-search wall time observed ~13-15s (retry path did not trigger during test window since no transient timeout occurred; the retry logic is present and code-reviewed correct). Grand total: 7 consecutive successful FLT2_4.1 runs (4 backend + 3 UI) all returning 91.
critical_code_review_comments: Retry ceiling is fixed at 3 attempts x (1.5s, 3s) backoff = up to ~4.5s added latency per failing subtree; consider surfacing a 'partial_results=true' flag when even after retries a sub-BOM lookup returns None, so the UI can warn users that a subtree was silently skipped (currently None subtrees are still swallowed at the caller).

pytest.ini uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope` — two long FLT2 searches on different classes get pinned to different workers and can concurrently hammer SAP, tripping a 502 at Cloudflare (reproduced in this iteration). Mitigation applied: stability class placed in TestBomSearch worker group. Consider adding a pytest xdist_group marker to explicitly pin all FLT2 tests, or run heavy SOAP tests serially.
Legacy sap_client.py (unused OData module) still in repo - candidate for deletion (carry-over).
test_credentials: N/A (no app auth). SAP SOAP creds in backend/.env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reliability fix verified stable over 7 consecutive FLT2_4.1 runs (4 pytest + 3 UI) — no 89-count regressions observed. INSTRUCTION MANUAL level-1 row consistently 6902-602142/FLT2_4.4. Regression 8060522_1=23/2 and invalid BOM 404 both intact. Note: retry logic path (SAPSoapError raised then retried) was not exercised during this window because no transient SAP timeouts occurred — code review confirms retry+backoff is correct in _safe_fetch_by_output_product.
rca_of_the_issue: Original intermittent 89-vs-91: transient SAP ReadTimeout under ~50 concurrent SelectionByOutputProductID sub-BOM lookups was silently swallowed by _safe_fetch_by_output_product (returned None), dropping the entire subtree. Fix (verified): retry up to 3 times with 1.5s/3s backoff before giving up. Verified by running 7 back-to-back FLT2_4.1 searches, all returning exactly 91 components.
